ShortDescription.Value: Hide notification clutter with a Mini HUD, instant icon controls, Road names, Road Arrows, District Names. Money Trends, Population Trends, Easy City Stats.

Publish.LongDescription:
### City Watchdog
Clean up notification clutter and keep your city easier to read while you build.
#### Features
* **Lower Stress**, reduce information overload. * **Video** of mod use: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IoAuewDJDt4&t=1s](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IoAuewDJDt4&t=1s). More features have been added since this video. * **Mini HUD** — track the notification problems you care about and click an icon to instant jump to problem locations. * **Show All / Hide All** — instantly show or hide all city notification icons. * **Active Issues** - click on the Sort button, top row until you see Active Issues. * **Road controls** — show/hide road names, district names, and show Road arrows. * **\[i\] button** — instantly show/hide vanilla mouse-over tooltips. * **Bigger UI** — quick access to the game's interface scaling without launching Developer Mode. * **Extra city info** — shows money Trends and additional population stats.
City Watchdog helps you see and manage city info — it does not fix city problems for you.
#### Good to know
- Open the main panel from the top-left Paw icon. - **Blue Stars** are Mini HUD favorites and are separate from Presets 1 | 2. - Safe to remove any time. No Harmony patches, less brittle on patch day. - **Presets 1 | 2** — save custom notification checkbox layouts (selecting this instead of the Hide ALL button will show just the ones you want). Presets was a player request. Personally I just use "Hide All" City Icons and use the Mini-HUD for a less stressful UI that also shows me my favorite issue problem icons in a small tidy panel. - Milestone and other items have been removed from this CWD mod are now in [Budget+Milestones mod](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/158395/Windows). If you want it similar to before, install both.
### Support and feedback
- Enjoy! Support by clicking LIKE 👍 (top right); helps people know about the mod. No donations requested. - Feedback is welcome through the GitHub or Discord buttons on the right.
### Credits and Thanks

Thumbnail photograph by Maryia Shedava at Mont Saint-Michel in Normandy, France: [https://unsplash.com/photos/a-dog-poses-in-front-of-a-distant-castle-bEpjaU\_CTcM](https://unsplash.com/photos/a-dog-poses-in-front-of-a-distant-castle-bEpjaU_CTcM)
**15 languages supported:** English, Deutsch, Español, Français, Italiano, 日本語, 한국어, Polski, Português Brasileiro, Português Portugal, ไทย, Türkçe, Tiếng Việt, 简体中文, 繁體中文.
